title: Keep a sample sketchpad immediate as control depth grows
summary: Build an eight-pad sound sketchpad with hold-slide controls, multi-edit, direct rearrangement, and explicit destructive moments.
originNote: A standard sampler interaction task sharpened by a newly curated official control reference supplied after the historical analysis.

setup.instructions: Mount the interaction packet. Build a self-contained browser prototype; synthesized tones may stand in for recorded audio and no external samples are allowed.

turns.content: Read fixtures/sketchpad.json and implement the complete eight-pad sound sketchpad as index.html. Preserve immediacy: tapping a filled pad plays it; holding an empty pad records a synthetic stand-in until release; holding Volume, Pitch, or Pan and sliding in any direction adjusts the selected pad; double-tapping one of those controls resets it. An explicit Edit hold enables multi-selection so one adjustment applies to all selected pads. Dragging one pad onto another must offer copy, swap, layer, or cancel; dragging to a revealed discard target uses the packet's confirmation rule. Provide keyboard equivalents and a visible action history. Do not reproduce any existing sampler's branding, layout, palette, pad count, labels, or chrome.

Revise the artifact so a person can capture, play, adjust, and resample a sound without opening a modal. Keep confirmations only where data would be destroyed or two occupied pads create an ambiguous merge. Preserve multi-edit and direct rearrangement.

checks.description: Eight pads, audio synthesis, and direct-manipulation handlers are present.
Capture, play, adjust, multi-edit, rearrange, discard, and resample using touch-sized controls and keyboard equivalents.
